name: ERPBench (state-grounded) v1 · T1
protocol: arXiv v1 Table 2 T1; screenshot-only 1280x720 ERPNext harness, automatic approval. Distinct from GAIR ERPBench market simulation.

summary.en: Tests whether screenshot-driven agents correctly persist business records in ERPNext.
summary.zh: 测试只依靠截图的 agent 能否在 ERPNext 中正确保存业务记录。

task_format.en: T1 single-field tasks, five runs each, 100 runs per model; no DOM or accessibility tree.
task_format.zh: T1 单字段任务，每题运行五次，每模型共 100 次；不提供 DOM 或无障碍树。

explanation.en: Table 2 T1 success: every target database field must match. T2/T3 and stage-level partial credit are separate.
explanation.zh: 采用表 2 的 T1 成功率：所有目标数据库字段都必须正确。T2/T3 和阶段部分分数另计。
